8 · What the code needs (for mod-engineer; nothing is edited here)

general.zs: rename CYBR to SDGN in every state line. The letters already match for A-P. The two Summon lines change their LETTERS too, as the file's comments say: 'CYBR E 15 Bright A_SD_GeneralSummon' becomes 'SDGN Q 15 Bright A_SD_GeneralSummon' and 'CYBR F 15' becomes 'SDGN R 15'.

general_shell.zs: Spawn 'MANF AB 4 Bright' becomes 'SDGL AB 4 Bright'; Death 'MISL B 8 Bright', 'MISL C 6 Bright', 'MISL D 4 Bright' become 'SDGL C 8 Bright', 'SDGL D 6 Bright', 'SDGL E 4 Bright' (new letters, BESTIARY 2.7). RenderStyle Add stays.

Lumps: 81 SDGN (A-G, Q, R at rotations 1-8; H-P at 0) and 5 SDGL (A-E at 0), each PNG with its grAb, to assets/sprites/general/ on the CEO's approval; MOD-SPEC 6.3 and check_pk3's placeholder list lose CYBR, MANF and MISL for this class.

Nothing else: no state, tic or action changes. The Q frame is Bright: GZDoom lights the WHOLE sprite on a Bright frame, which suits the order being shouted.

10 · Honest verdict and what you decide

WHAT THIS IS. D72: the CD turnaround, approved, drawn in every frame general.zs names: A-D the walk (the coat's hem and the cloak sway; Spawn idles on A B), E F the salvo (E aims the stick, F fires: the field gun's flash on his shoulder), G the pain (struck in the chest, he rocks back and clutches it), Q R the summon (Q, Bright: 'Vorwärts!', his fist raised; R: he points the recruits on), at 8 drawn rotations; H-P the death at rotation 0. 81 SDGN lumps and the shell's 5 SDGL. The turnaround's views are its pixels byte for byte (11 of 11: SDGNA1, SDGNA2, SDGNA3, SDGNA4, SDGNA5, SDGNA6, SDGNA7, SDGNA8, SDGNF1, SDGNF3, SDGNF5).

THE CLOAK FROM THE FRONT. At rotation 1 not one pixel of the cloak shows in any living frame: A 0, B 0, C 0, D 0, E 0, F 0, G 0, Q 0, R 0 (tests/test_gen_general.py holds it). It sways only backwards and with the hem, never out past the coat.

THE DEATH. Hit in the chest at H (the burst, the hole in the chrome), his knees go and the cap flies off at I (the field gun knocked up on its cradle), he falls back over his heels twisting at J while the gun is torn off, lands at K, and from L lies on his back across the screen on his cloak, spread under him on the floor: the Reich's red with its disc on the near side, the stars and stripes on the far side. Head, arms and legs are each let fall until they touch; the cap and the gun lie beside him; the pool grows from his chest onto the flags (M-P). Measured on the corpse P (section 5): every part within 2 units of the floor, the body 20.68 units high at most (the test: under 28; his cuirass is thick), the supports spread 80.1 units, the torso across the screen (1.0); the cap and the gun lie 10.56 units high at most. Blood is H 2%, I 8%, J 6%, K 7%, L 7%, M 8%, N 12%, O 16%, P 18% of the death frames' pixels.

WHAT DOES NOT, HONESTLY. (1) E and F share the pose but for the stick and the flash: from the front E reads as 'F without the flash', which is Doom's own E/F rhythm (the Cyberdemon's). (2) The walk's four frames differ mostly in the legs under a coat that only sways: from the front the stride is boots; the side views show it. (3) Q's raised fist makes the sprite taller than his 100-unit actor (the arm over the cap), as Doom's raised arms do. (4) The corpse is big: he is 100 units, so lying he is ~100 px across, the cloak's fan wider still; it is the biggest corpse in the game, as he is the biggest man. (5) The spread cloak is drawn as straight stripes radiating from his shoulders: cloth seen from 37 degrees, not folds. (6) Light is gen_enemy's stand-in, NOT VERIFIED against GZDoom; nothing here has been in the engine.

For the CEO
  1. Approve the 81 SDGN and 5 SDGL lumps as drawn, or name the frames to redo (the corpse P above all: does he lie naturally on his flags?).
  2. On approval: mod-engineer installs them and makes the code changes listed in section 8.
